user.title: Connect to TaskBandit
user.description: Where does your TaskBandit run? First create a token in TaskBandit under Settings → Home Assistant.

cloud.title: TaskBandit Cloud
cloud.description: Paste the token you created in TaskBandit under Settings → Home Assistant.

self_hosted.title: Self-hosted TaskBandit
self_hosted.description: Enter your server's address (filled in when Home Assistant found it on the network) and the token from Settings → Home Assistant.

data_description.url: The address of your TaskBandit server, with its port
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn off only if your server uses a self-signed certificate

members.title: Who is who
members.description: Pick the Home Assistant person for each TaskBandit member in {household}, like matching a vacuum's rooms to areas. Choose "Not in Home Assistant" for members who don't use it. People nobody is matched to simply aren't TaskBandit members. This decides who gets the credit when someone presses a routine button or ticks off a chore, and who is reported home.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate TaskBandit
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {url} no longer works. Create a new token in TaskBandit and enter it here.

error.invalid_auth: TaskBandit rejected the token. Check it hasn't been revoked.
error.feature_disabled: The Home Assistant feature is turned off for this TaskBandit household.
error.missing_scope: The token isn't allowed to read the household status.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach the TaskBandit server. Check the address.
error.person_used_twice: Each Home Assistant person can be matched to only one member.

abort.already_configured: This household is already set up.
abort.wrong_household: That token belongs to a different household.

init.title: TaskBandit options
